title: Who can do what in the bot?
description: Three simple steps: sort your Discord roles into levels, choose the level each feature is available from, and try it out with the simulator.
rolesUnavailable: The server’s roles can’t be loaded right now (Discord error) — try again in a minute.
integrationRole: integration (bot) role — can’t be assigned to a level
savedText: The bot will pick them up within a few seconds.
readOnly: Roles and permissions can only be changed by the server owner or a Discord administrator (just like in the bot). You can only view them.
how1: You sort your Discord roles into Staff, Moderator or Admin. Anyone on a higher level also gets the permissions of the lower levels.
how2: For each feature you choose the level it’s available from — or add extra roles that can use it regardless of level.
how3: Pick a role below and we’ll show you exactly what someone with it can do in the bot.
ladderNote: The Server admin (Discord “Administrator” permission) and Owner levels aren’t granted by roles — they are always at the top.
step1: Step 1 — Who is on which level?
legacyStaff: + @{role} (Settings → Roles → Staff role also counts as Staff level)
unlocks: {count, plural, one {Available from this level: # feature} other {Available from this level: # features}}
unlocksNone: — no feature unlocks at exactly this level
discordFallbackHint: + anyone with the “{perm}” permission on Discord
fallbackText: When on, anyone who has the matching permission on Discord (e.g. Ban Members → ban) can also use the bot’s command, regardless of level. When off, only the levels and extra roles above count.
step3: Step 3 — Try it: what can a role do?
simText: Choose the roles of an imaginary member — we’ll show you what they can do in the bot according to your (not yet saved) settings.
